Warrior of the realm of the dead who has
entered a contract with the heavens. Kills Hel,
the ruler of the dead, and usurps her power.

Mythic Effect: Dark
Boost: HP+5, Atk+3

Grants allies this Mythic Effect during Dark
season, if the Dark blessing has been conferred
and if this unit enters battle in Aether Raids with
them: Dark-blessed allies decrease the
Aetheric Lift lost for defense failures during
Dark season. (This decrease is limited to the
number of Mythic Heroes (Max: 2) × the number
of Heroes with the blessing conferred × 5.)

During Dark season, this Mythic Hero will
decrease Aetheric Lift loss for defense
failures depending on number of merges. (This
decrease is limited to the number of times the
units have been merged × 1 (Max: 20).)

Mythic Effect 2: Dark
Boost: Defensive Team Bonus

Mythic Effect 3: Dark
Boost: Defensive Team Call
(Details can be found in Edit Defensive Team.)

Cancels Great Talent bonuses for foes
without magic or staves! Declares
death on foes, reaping life with allies.

Creates Divine Vein (Ice), providing
total defense! Turns energy from foes'
attacks into an intense counterattack!

When Special triggers, boosts damage by unit's
Def.

Reduces damage from foe's first attack by 40%
during combat ("first attack" normally means
only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit
attacks twice," it means the first and second
strikes), and if unit has weapon-triangle
advantage or if unit and foe are colorless,
grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit during
combat.

$aUnit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants
【Atk Liberate】,【Def Liberate】, and【Reflex】
to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for
1 turn.

After start-of-turn effects trigger on enemy
phase, if unit's space has no Divine Vein effect
applied by unit's team, applies
【Divine Vein (Ice)】to that space for 1 turn
(excludes warp spaces in Rival Domains).

If foe initiates combat against an ally on the
map and the ally is defeated in combat, applies
【Divine Vein (Ice)】to unit's space and
that ally's space after combat for 1 turn
(excludes warp spaces in Rival Domains).

Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+10 to unit, unit deals
+7 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials),
reduces damage from foe's attacks by 7
(excluding area-of-effect Specials), and
neutralizes effects that inflict "Special
cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.

If unit's space has a Divine Vein effect applied
by unit's team, damage from foe's attacks is
reduced to 0 during combat (excluding
area-of-effect Specials; Røkkr take at least
1 damage).

If unit's space has a Divine Vein effect applied
by unit's team after combat, neutralizes that
Divine Vein effect. (If a Divine Vein effect is
applied, destroyed, and neutralized at the same
time, application, destruction, and neutralization
of the effect are processed in order.)

【Atk Liberate】
Grants bonus to Atk during combat = number
of Bonus effects active on unit, excluding
stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).

【Def Liberate】
Grants bonus to Def during combat = number
of Bonus effects active on unit, excluding
stat bonuses, + 4 (max 8).

【Reflex】
Reduces damage from foe's first attack by 7
during combat ("first attack" normally means
only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit
attacks twice," it means the first and second
strikes) and unit's next attack deals damage =
total damage reduced from foe's first attack
(by any source, including other skills; resets at
end of combat). (For 1 turn.)

【Divine Vein (Ice)】
Applies the following status on space: Foes
treat space as impassable terrain while status
is active, but status is destructible (with 1 HP).
Allies can move into and occupy space. If any
allies occupy spaces with Divine Vein (Ice)
applied, attacks targeting those spaces will hit
the ally over destroying the Divine Vein (Ice).
(Does not trigger in Pawns of Loki.)

$aUnit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.
